title: Postdoctoral Positions in Gravitational-Wave Science
institution: Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics (Albert Einstein Institute)
about: Postdoctoral appointments of two to five years in the Astrophysical and Cosmological Relativity department, including positions linked to an ERC Synergy Grant, the Simons Collaboration on Black Holes and Strong Gravity, and a Center of Gravity post shared between Potsdam and Copenhagen. Start Fall 2027.
requirements: Cover letter, CV, publication list, research statement (max. three pages)
Three referees; letters must arrive by the deadline
